import json,hashlib,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
d=json.loads(Path('/mnt/trusted.json').read_text());hist=np.zeros(23,dtype=np.int64);total=0;seen=set()
for r in d['rows']:
 source=Path('/tmp/native')/r['artifact'];assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256'];name='return-'+str(r['return'])+'.npz';pred=Path('/source')/name;assert hashlib.sha256(pred.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==d['predictions'][name]
 with np.load(source,allow_pickle=False) as original,np.load(pred,allow_pickle=False) as output:
  assert np.array_equal(original['pixels'],output['pixels']);p=output['predictions'];labels=original['segmentation'][:,1];assert p.shape==(r['points'],) and p.dtype.kind in 'iu' and np.all((p>=0)&(p<=22));hist+=np.bincount(labels,minlength=23);total+=len(p)
  assert len(np.unique(output['pixels'],axis=0))==len(p)
  key=(r['context'],r['timestamp'],r['laser'],r['return']);assert key not in seen;seen.add(key)
assert hist.tolist()==d['expected_counts'];report={'points':total,'eligible_points':int(hist[1:].sum()),'native_counts':hist.tolist(),'identity':'both TOP returns retain every original row/column in source order','scope':'native engineering point identity/coverage only; untrained predictions are not accuracy evidence'};Path('/outputs/check.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print('PASS independent native semantic identities',total,report['eligible_points'])
